title: A session fast-forwards its own clean checkout to main at start
why: Ruling fast-forward-clean-start (owner 21:59 CST Nov 12) had no step that builds it. Its step field pointed at grants-read-from-main, which is about the grant warning and hook timeout (Degen D14 part a).

note: Build the ruling's shape: only the session's own worktree; clean means no edits, no commits ahead, no merge or rebase in progress, and on the default branch; fast-forward only; only at session start or an owner prompt; one line printed.
